name: DisplayFormat
description: Represents the display settings for an associated Range object. Read-only.
remarks: Actions such as changing the conditional formatting or table style of a range can cause what is displayed in the current user interface to be inconsistent with the values in the corresponding properties of the Range object. Use the properties of the DisplayFormat object to return the values as they are displayed in the current user interface.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Borders
properties.description: Returns a Borders object that represents the borders of the associated Range object as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.

properties.name: Characters
properties.description: Returns a Characters object that represents a range of characters within the text of the associated Range object as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Returns a Font object that represents the font of the associated Range as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Returns a value, containing a Style object, that represents the style of the associated Range object as it is displayed in the current user interface.

properties.name: AddIndent
properties.description: Returns a value that indicates if Microsoft Excel automatically indents text of the associated Range object when the text alignment in a cell is set to equal distribution (either horizontally or vertically), as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.

properties.name: FormulaHidden
properties.description: Returns a value that indicates if the formula of the associated Range object is hidden when the worksheet is protected as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.

properties.name: HorizontalAlignment
properties.description: Returns a value that represents the horizontal alignment of the associated Range object as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.

properties.name: IndentLevel
properties.description: Returns a value that represents the indent level of the associated Range object as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.

properties.name: Interior
properties.description: Returns an Interior object that represents the interior of the associated Range object as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.

properties.name: Locked
properties.description: Returns a value that indicates if the associated Range object is locked as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.

properties.name: MergeCells
properties.description: Returns a value that indicates if the associated Range object contains merged cells as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.

properties.name: NumberFormat
properties.description: Returns a value that represents the format code of the associated Range object as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.

properties.name: NumberFormatLocal
properties.description: Returns a value that represents the format code of the associated Range object as a string in the language of the user as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns a value that represents the text orientation of the associated Range object as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.

properties.name: ReadingOrder
properties.description: Returns the reading order of the associated Range object as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.

properties.name: ShrinkToFit
properties.description: Returns a value that indicates if Microsoft Excel automatically shrinks text to fit in the available column width of the associated Range object as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.

properties.name: VerticalAlignment
properties.description: Returns a value that represents the vertical alignment of the associated Range object as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.

properties.name: WrapText
properties.description: Returns a value that indicates if Microsoft Excel wraps the text of the associated Range object as it is displayed in the current user interface. Read-only.
